GRAIN-FAMILY FIXTURE WARNING: the duration-formula fixture's flat noise registers as ONE grain - grain reverse REFUSES on it ('No grains found.'), and timewarp/rerhythm/reposition rows only hold at their neutral pins; duplicate is fully fixture-compatible. rerhythm/reposition rows additionally need their aux data file written before the run.

seed_hunt.question: Would any grain-family entry be the SEEDED mono stochastic entry that triggers the deferred stereo seed-linking machinery?
seed_hunt.answer: No. The grain program has no seed flag in any of its 15 modes and dev/grain contains no srand call; its only drand48 uses are in r_extend (timestretch_iterative, rand_ints_with_restricted_repeats/do_repet_restricted_perm - ASC/PSC scatter) and noise_extend (grab_noise_and_expand), and via the osbind.c drand48 shim (rand()/RAND_MAX; nm shows T drand48 + U srand) those paths run from rand()'s fixed default seed - deterministic every run, unseeded and unseedable (the tranche-2 modify-revecho mechanism). All five shipped grain modes verified decoded-identical 1.1 s apart.
seed_hunt.trigger_candidate: scramble scramble (CDP8-era waveset scrambler, dev/science/scramble.c): seed is a REQUIRED positional 0-256 and it WORKS - line 1123 srand(dz->iparam[SCR_SEED]) seeds the rand() behind the drand48 shim (the same path that makes revecho's seed Windows-only). Verified: seed 5 twice decoded-identical; seed 5 vs 9 differ; no unseeded/clock path exists. MONO ONLY ('ERROR: INVALID DATA / ERROR: File st2.wav is not of correct type (must be mono)'). If curated, THIS entry poses the stereo seed-linking question (channel split -> per-channel seeds -> interleave). Recorded only; no channel machinery built this tranche.
